summary: Verified the service-worker/reload-loop fix in /app/frontend/src/index.js. The preview no longer flashes: after first load (which unregisters any stale SW) and a subsequent reload, only a single main-frame navigation was recorded over a 10s observation window. navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistrations().length === 0 and caches.keys().length === 0 in the dev preview, confirming the SW is not being registered. All three regression checks pass: activation gate renders, main app renders after setting hotlive95_license (My License button visible, DJ Playout Studio UI stable), and /license and /live routes render without a reload loop.

issues: Known React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — not related to reload loop, noted as separate hygiene item

critical_code_review_comments: index.js SW gate is correct: registration only under NODE_ENV==='production'; dev path unregisters existing SWs and clears caches. Guard against Electron via window.hotlive.isElectron is preserved.
seed_data_creation: Set localStorage.hotlive95_license = {activated:true, legalAccepted:true, online:false, key:'QA-KEY', activatedAt:<ISO now>} to bypass activation gate during regression checks.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix for repeated flashing/reload caused by CRA dev-preview service worker is fully verified. Measurements: 2nd load nav_count=1 over 10s; SW regs=0; caches=0. Activation gate + activated main app + /license + /route render stably. Any future flashing report should first check that public/sw.js is not being registered in dev.
rca of the issue: Root cause: public/sw.js was registered unconditionally on 'load' in index.js. In the CRA dev preview, the service worker intercepts fetches while webpack-dev-server / hot reload still tries to control the page, producing a navigation/refresh loop. Fix: gate the register() call on process.env.NODE_ENV==='production' and, in dev, actively unregister existing registrations and clear caches so already-affected users self-heal on next visit.
